title: DAG-ML sealed captured host HPO publication v2
$comment: A publication pairs one sealed checkpoint with the owner state observed after the last transition. pair_fingerprint is the TCV1 digest of {checkpoint_fingerprint, native_checkpoint, structural_binding when present}. owner_checkpoint_fingerprint is the canonical digest defined by proposal_state. A null pair is honest unavailability and refuses qualified resume. An aborted window publishes nothing. fingerprint seals (schema_version, checkpoint.fingerprint, source_digest, attempts, pending_attempts). structural_binding is null here when absent, but an absent binding is omitted from the pair preimage rather than encoded as null, so a producer must drop the key to reach the same digest. Known limit: a publication does not name its publisher, so reuse of a capture id whose publication holds only unterminated replays cannot be detected.

pending_attempt.$comment: An asked trial that is still RUNNING at publication. It replays from these sealed values without a new ask.
